import pandas as pd

# File paths for source CSVs
source_files = [
    "autopipeline-benchmarks/github-pipelines/intermediate_space/length6_22/training_0.csv",
    "autopipeline-benchmarks/github-pipelines/intermediate_space/length6_22/training_1.csv",
    "autopipeline-benchmarks/github-pipelines/intermediate_space/length6_22/training_2.csv",
    "autopipeline-benchmarks/github-pipelines/intermediate_space/length6_22/training_3.csv",
    "autopipeline-benchmarks/github-pipelines/intermediate_space/length6_22/training_4.csv",
    "autopipeline-benchmarks/github-pipelines/intermediate_space/length6_22/training_5.csv",
]

# Read all source files with index_col=0 to ignore the numerical index column
dfs = [pd.read_csv(f, index_col=0) for f in source_files]

# Concatenate all source dataframes (UNION operation)
df = pd.concat(dfs, ignore_index=True)

# Ensure columns are in the exact order and types as target schema:
# Target schema:
# ['Timestamp [ms]': int, 'CPU cores': int, 'CPU capacity provisioned [MHZ]': float,
#  'CPU usage [MHZ]': float, 'CPU usage [%]': float, 'Memory capacity provisioned [KB]': int,
#  'Memory usage [KB]': float, 'Disk read throughput [KB/s]': int, 'Disk write throughput [KB/s]': float,
#  'Network received throughput [KB/s]': float, 'Network transmitted throughput [KB/s]': float, 'Timestamp': string]

# Cast columns to correct types
df['Timestamp [ms]'] = df['Timestamp [ms]'].astype('int64')
df['CPU cores'] = df['CPU cores'].astype('int64')
df['CPU capacity provisioned [MHZ]'] = df['CPU capacity provisioned [MHZ]'].astype('float64')
df['CPU usage [MHZ]'] = df['CPU usage [MHZ]'].astype('float64')
df['CPU usage [%]'] = df['CPU usage [%]'].astype('float64')
df['Memory capacity provisioned [KB]'] = df['Memory capacity provisioned [KB]'].astype('int64')
df['Memory usage [KB]'] = df['Memory usage [KB]'].astype('float64')
df['Disk read throughput [KB/s]'] = df['Disk read throughput [KB/s]'].astype('int64')
df['Disk write throughput [KB/s]'] = df['Disk write throughput [KB/s]'].astype('float64')
df['Network received throughput [KB/s]'] = df['Network received throughput [KB/s]'].astype('float64')
df['Network transmitted throughput [KB/s]'] = df['Network transmitted throughput [KB/s]'].astype('float64')

# The 'Timestamp' column is already present in the source files as string datetime, ensure it's string type
df['Timestamp'] = df['Timestamp'].astype(str)

# Reorder columns exactly as target schema
target_columns = [
    'Timestamp [ms]',
    'CPU cores',
    'CPU capacity provisioned [MHZ]',
    'CPU usage [MHZ]',
    'CPU usage [%]',
    'Memory capacity provisioned [KB]',
    'Memory usage [KB]',
    'Disk read throughput [KB/s]',
    'Disk write throughput [KB/s]',
    'Network received throughput [KB/s]',
    'Network transmitted throughput [KB/s]',
    'Timestamp'
]

df = df[target_columns]

# Write the final dataframe to the target CSV file without the index
df.to_csv("autopipeline-benchmarks/github-pipelines/length6_22/target_multisource.csv", index=False)

df5 = pd.read_csv('autopipeline-benchmarks/github-pipelines/length6_22/training_5.csv', index_col=0)

# UNION all source tables
df = pd.concat([df0, df1, df2, df3, df4, df5], ignore_index=True)

# GROUP BY the leftmost integer columns in target schema that are likely unique:
# 'Timestamp [ms]', 'CPU cores', 'Memory capacity provisioned [KB]', 'Disk read throughput [KB/s]'
# Aggregate float columns by max to avoid inflating values
group_by_cols = ['Timestamp [ms]', 'CPU cores', 'Memory capacity provisioned [KB]', 'Disk read throughput [KB/s]']

agg_dict = {
    'CPU capacity provisioned [MHZ]': 'max',
    'CPU usage [MHZ]': 'max',
    'CPU usage [%]': 'max',
    'Memory usage [KB]': 'max',
    'Disk write throughput [KB/s]': 'max',

}
